slides.title: Three suspects. One stolen ring. Only one detail gives the thief away.
Meera, the cook: "I was in the kitchen. The milk boiled over at 8:15, I was cleaning it."
Arjun, the driver: "I was washing the car. It was so sunny, I finished by 8."
Sita, the neighbour: "I came at 9 for sugar. The ring was already missing."
The ring vanished between 8 and 8:30 PM.
Who did it? Comment the name.
